import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

coll = bpy.data.collections.get('01 ELEVADOR OFICIAL | esboco original')
if coll is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Colecao oficial nao encontrada')

# World-space bounds per object and union.
def wb(o):
    pts = [o.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    mins = [min(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)]
    maxs = [max(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)]
    return mins, maxs

items=[]
union_min=[float('inf')]*3
union_max=[float('-inf')]*3
for o in coll.all_objects:
    if o.type not in {'MESH','CURVE','FONT'}:
        continue
    mn,mx=wb(o)
    for i in range(3):
        union_min[i]=min(union_min[i],mn[i]); union_max[i]=max(union_max[i],mx[i])
    dims=[mx[i]-mn[i] for i in range(3)]
    items.append((o.name, tuple(round(v,3) for v in o.location), tuple(round(v,3) for v in dims), round(mn[2],3), round(mx[2],3)))

print('FILE='+bpy.data.filepath)
print('SCENE='+bpy.context.scene.name)
print('COLLECTION_OBJECTS='+str(len(items)))
print('UNION_MIN='+str(tuple(round(v,3) for v in union_min)))
print('UNION_MAX='+str(tuple(round(v,3) for v in union_max)))
print('UNION_DIMS='+str(tuple(round(union_max[i]-union_min[i],3) for i in range(3))))
for row in sorted(items):
    n=row[0].lower()
    if any(k in n for k in ['torre','passarela','entrada superior','terminal alto','cidade baixa','desembarque','galeria','acesso inferior']):
        print(row)
